rules.statement: Where a person executed three deeds of gift on the same day and certain lands donated by one deed were included in another, the earlier deed must prevail.
rules.supporting_quote: Where a person executed three deeds of gift in favour of three sons on the same day and where certain lands donated by one deed were included in another,- Held, that the earlier deed must prevail and that there was a presumption that the Notary did his duty properly and that he numbered them in the order in which they were executed.
